title: Import Test — Scorched Sight
description: The flames caught your face and the world has gone to smeared white shapes. You cannot see well enough to trust what you are swinging at.
treatment: A successful Medicine check, or any magical healing that restores sight.
gmnotes: Import verification fixture. Exercises the fields a flat payload cannot: a nested modifiers array (the path bug), a null treatmentdc, a lowercase category that must land in a title-cased journal, and a real condition.
